attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 24, `fadA` to `rarD`, are carried by 98 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 27% of calls. The model names 34 to 100% of them, fewest at column 20, `rhtC`, 34%.

**The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 96%, and hesitates less there, 0.16 against 0.21 bits. It hesitates most at column 25, `yigG`, a fork column, 0.70 bits.

**The window ends on persistent families.** Columns 64 to 79, `ilvC` to `rbsK`, are carried from 82 to 32% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 95% of genes**, 0.17 bits on average, perplexity 1.2 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.49 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 96%.

label: fadA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the fadA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor fadA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,280 to 4,359 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying fadA once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.17 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 38,146 calls, named 97%, 0.11 bits; shell 4,698 calls, named 79%, 0.63 bits; cloud 116 calls, named 2%, 2.70 bits. Outside an RGP 40,027 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 2,933 calls, named 85%, 0.49 bits. Columns: 58 spine, 3 fork, 19 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.49 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 96%); 2,933 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 25 (yigG, a fork column) 0.70 bits, RGP 33%; column 36 (cyaY, a spine column) 0.46 bits, RGP 2%; column 42 (aslA, a variable column) 0.46 bits, RGP 5%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 58 spine columns: named 94%, 0.16 bits on average; the 22 fork and variable columns: named 96%, 0.21 bits. The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 25, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 25-26 (fork), RGP 31-33%; the least: columns 61-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0.2-1%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-24 (25 columns) spine: share 98-100%, all P, RGP 0-27%. Genes: fadA, fre, ubiD, rfaH, tatD, tatC "Sec-independent protein translocase…", tatB, tatA, ubiB "ubiquinone biosynthesis regulatory…", ubiJ, ubiE, rmuC, udp, ysgA "dienelactone hydrolase family prote…", metE "5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutama…", metR, bioP, yigL "sugar/pyridoxal phosphate phosphata…", pldB, rhtB "homoserine/homoserine lactone efflu…", rhtC, recQ, pldA, yigI "acyl-CoA thioesterase YigI", rarD. named 34-100% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 20 (rhtC), named 34%; most hesitant at column 14 (metE), 0.43 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 25-26 (2 columns) fork: share 66-67%, all S, RGP 31-33%. named 88-90% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 26, named 88%; most hesitant at column 25, 0.70 bits.
[S2.c25]    25: yigG S 67% "protein YigG"; also "allophanate hydrolase-related protein" S 25%, "IS1 family transposase" S 13%
[S2.c26]    26: yigF S 66% "DUF2628 domain-containing protein"; also "cytosine permease" S 25%
[S3] 3. columns 27-41 (15 columns) spine: share 93-99%, all P, RGP 1-29%. Genes: corA, ysgD "protein YsgD", yigE "phosphodiester glycosidase family p…", uvrD, yigB "5-amino-6-(5-phospho-D-ribitylamino…", xerC, yigA "DUF484 domain-containing protein", dapF, lptM, cyaY, cyaA "class I adenylate cyclase", hemC, hemD "uroporphyrinogen-III synthase", hemX, hemY. named 50-97% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 28 (ysgD), named 50%; most hesitant at column 36 (cyaY), 0.46 bits.
[S4] 4. column 42 variable: share 80%, all S, RGP 5%. named 89%; 0.46 bits.
[S4.c42]    42: aslA S 80%
[S5] 5. columns 43-60 (18 columns) spine: share 90-99%, all P, RGP 0.2-3%. Genes: aslB "anaerobic sulfatase maturase", thrP, wecG, wzyE, rffT, wzxE, rffA "dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxygalactose t…", rffC, rfbA, rffG, wecC, wecB "non-hydrolyzing UDP-N-acetylglucosa…", wzzE, wecA, rho, rhoL, trxA, rhlB. named 94-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 43 (aslB), named 94%, 0.32 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 61-79 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: share 32-88%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. named 89-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 63, named 89%, 0.35 bits.
[S6.c61]    61 variable: gppA P 88%
[S6.c62]    62 variable: rep P 88%
[S6.c63]    63 fork: ppiC P 86%; also yifO S 43%
[S6.c64-79]    columns 64-79 variable, share 32-82%, all P: ilvC 82%, ilvY 80%, ilvA 77%, ilvD 76%, ilvE 75%, ilvM 75%, ilvG "acetolactate synthase 2 catalytic s…" 73%, ilvX 72%, ilvL 72%, yifB "YifB family Mg chelatase-like AAA A…" 65%, maoP 67%, hdfR 64%, yieP "FadR/GntR family transcriptional re…" 59%, mdtD 52%, rbsR "ribose operon transcriptional repre…" 46%, rbsK 32%
[Q] GROUPS whose products agree, the places for a [[ ]] (name that group's columns exactly, cite its line and [Q], make one phrase from its words): columns 4-7 (tatD to tatA) [S1]: independent, sec-independent, translocase; columns 8-10 (ubiB to ubiE) [S1]: biosynthesis, ubiquinone; columns 38-41 (hemC to hemY) [S3]: synthase, uroporphyrinogen, uroporphyrinogen-iii.
[X] PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): tatD 3'-5' ssDNA/RNA exonuclease TatD; tatB Sec-independent protein translocase pro…; tatA Sec-independent protein translocase sub…; ubiJ ubiquinone biosynthesis protein UbiJ; ubiE bifunctional demethylmenaquinone methyl…; metR HTH-type transcriptional regulator MetR; rhtC threonine export protein RhtC; hemC hydroxymethylbilane synthase; hemX uroporphyrinogen-III C-methyltransferase; hemY protoheme IX biogenesis protein HemY; aslA arylsulfatase AslA; rffC dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose ac…; wecC UDP-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine dehydrogenase; rho transcription termination factor Rho; ilvC ketol-acid reductoisomerase; ilvY HTH-type transcriptional activator IlvY; ilvA threonine ammonia-lyase, biosynthetic; ilvD dihydroxy-acid dehydratase; ilvE branched-chain-amino-acid transaminase; ilvM acetolactate synthase 2 small subunit; rbsK ribokinase; fdrA acyl-CoA synthetase FdrA; arcC carbamate kinase; tkt transketolase; ptsG glucose-specific PTS transporter subuni…; hxlB 6-phospho-3-hexuloisomerase; yifO type II toxin-antitoxin system PemK/Maz…
[E] END: the window ends at column 79, rbsK, in 32% of chromosomes.
